description: Fix frontend bugs, UX issues, and improve robustness of the client-side code
steps: Fix potential memory leak in the streaming timer (app.js): state._streamInterval is set via setInterval but clearInterval is only called in toggleStreamingUI(false). If the browser tab stays active across many messages, rapid toggling could leave orphan intervals. Add a guard to clear any existing interval before creating a new one.

Fix the LCS diff algorithm performance for large files (app.js diffLines function around line 2800): the O(n*m) DP table uses Int32Array but for files with thousands of lines this creates a huge matrix. Add a line count guard (e.g. skip full diff for files over 2000 lines and show a summary instead).

Fix potential XSS in tool run results display (app.js toolRunsHtml): tool results are escaped via esc() in a <pre> tag, but the 4000-char slice could still cause rendering issues. This is safe but ensure consistency - verify esc() handles all edge cases including backticks and null bytes.

Fix conversation search performance: renderConversations (app.js) does a full scan of all messages for the search query. For users with many conversations this will be slow. Add debouncing to the search input (it already has a handler but no debounce).

Fix the autonomous mode confirm dialog using native confirm(): this blocks the main thread and is jarring UX. Consider replacing with a non-blocking custom modal that matches the app's premium design.

Fix missing error boundary in the init() function: if loadConvosFromServer() or fetch('/api/config') fails with a non-network error (e.g. JSON parse error), the app could silently break. Add explicit try/catch with user-facing error messages.
acceptance_criteria: No duplicate intervals can accumulate during streaming
Diff viewer handles files over 2000 lines gracefully without freezing the browser
Search input in the sidebar has debounce behavior
The app initializes without errors even when server returns malformed data
verification: Run: env -u NODE_OPTIONS node --check public/app.js (syntax check)
findings: All 4 acceptance criteria satisfied. (1) Streaming timer: clearInterval guard added before setInterval to prevent orphan intervals on rapid toggling. (2) Diff performance: files over 2000 lines skip LCS and show simplified all-del/all-add output. (3) Search debounce: 200ms timeout on sidebar search input. (4) Init robustness: try/catch around renderConversations/renderMessages with recovery path that clears corrupted state. Node --check passes for both server.js and public/app.js.
